children: Corporate Bitcoin holdings have increased by 193,000 BTC this year, while individual investors have reduced their holdings by 93,000 BTC.
Cointelegraph reported on October 9 that corporate Bitcoin holdings rose by 193,000 BTC from January through October 5 this year.
Over the same period, individual investors' Bitcoin holdings fell by 93,000 BTC.
The gap between the changes in corporate and individual investor holdings totaled 286,000 BTC.

title: Corporate Bitcoin Holdings Up 193,000 This Year, While Retail Investors Cut 93,000
